cases.description: This discards the result of `tasks.enqueue` and always increments the work counter, which -- if I understand correctly -- effectively prevent the chip from going to sleep once a task has failed to be enqueued. Fixed in ce9c08498a22fb341c91945797dc7e4a9f59c60a.
